description:
🍨 Homemade Häagen-Dazs Chocolate Hazelnut Ice Cream | Ultra-Premium Ice Cream Recipe

In today’s video, I’m recreating a Häagen-Dazs Chocolate Hazelnut Ice Cream — rich, dense, ultra-creamy, and packed with deep chocolate flavour PLUS a silky hazelnut ganache swirl that is infinitely better than the actual rubbish one Häagen Dazs actually use now. 
This recipe follows proper ice-cream-science ratios for fat, solids, and emulsifiers to get that unmistakable premium texture at home.

Below you’ll find the full ingredient list (including cup measurements) and the exact timestamps for the video. Enjoy!

⸻

📌 FULL RECIPE

🍫 Ice Cream Base Ingredients
 • 700 g Milk (2%) — 2.75 cups
 • 327 g Cream (33%) — 1.3 cups
 • 257 g Sugar — 1.25 cups
 • 65 g Skim Milk Powder (SMP) — 0.5 cups
 • 35 g of 70% Dark Chocolate — 0.25 cup chopped
 • 45 g Cocoa Powder (20–24% fat) — 0.5 cup sifted
 • 60 g Egg Yolks — 3 large yolks (≈ 0.25 cup)
 • 5 g Vanilla Extract — 1 tsp

⸻

🌰 Hazelnut Ganache Swirl
 • 150 g Milk Chocolate (40–45%) — 0.75 cups chopped
 • 15 g Cocoa Powder — 0.25 cups
 • 60 g Whole Milk — 0.25 cup
 • 20 g Coconut Oil (refined) — 4 tsp
 • 10 g Glucose Syrup or Honey (optional) — 2 tsp
 • 7g Hazelnut Extract — 1.5 tsp

⸻

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS

00:00 — Intro
01:09 — Their Ingredients overview and info
02:06 — My ingredients and overview
03:14 — Making the base
05:59 — Pre chill and making the hazelnut ganache add in
06:57 — Loading up
07:24 — Scooping and reveal
07:48 — Eating and the hardship that is AMAZING ice cream
08:59 — Outro

⸻
